name: ACTION
description: Initial action called after the installer is initialized.

name: ADDDEFAULT
description: List of features to be installed in the default configuration.

name: ADDLOCAL
description: List of features to be installed locally.

name: ADDSOURCE
description: List of features to be run from source.

name: ADVERTISE
description: List of features to be advertised.

name: AFTERREBOOT
description: Indicates current installation follows a reboot that the ForceReboot action invokes.

name: ALLUSERS
description: Determines where configuration information is stored.

name: ARPAUTHORIZEDCDFPREFIX
description: URL of the update channel for an application.

name: ARPCOMMENTS
description: Provides Comments for the Add or Remove Programs in Control Panel.

name: ARPCONTACT
description: Provides Contact for the Add or Remove Programs in Control Panel.

name: ARPHELPLINK
description: Internet address or URL for technical support.

name: ARPHELPTELEPHONE
description: Technical support phone numbers.

name: ARPINSTALLLOCATION
description: Fully qualified path to the primary folder of an application.

name: ARPNOMODIFY
description: Disables functionality that modifies a product.

name: ARPNOREMOVE
description: Disables functionality that removes a product.

name: ARPNOREPAIR
description: Disables the Repair button in the Programs wizard.

name: ARPPRODUCTICON
description: Specifies the primary icon for the installation package.

name: ARPREADME
description: Provides a ReadMe for the Add or Remove Programs in Control Panel.

name: ARPSIZE
description: Estimated size of an application in kilobytes.

name: ARPSYSTEMCOMPONENT
description: Prevents display of an application in the Add or Remove Programs list.

name: ARPURLINFOABOUT
description: URL for the home page of an application.

name: ARPURLUPDATEINFO
description: URL for application update information.

name: AVAILABLEFREEREG
description: Registry space (in kilobytes) that an application requires. Used by AllocateRegistrySpace action.

name: AdminProperties
description: List of properties that are set during an administration installation.

name: AdminToolsFolder
description: The full path to the directory that contains administrative tools.

name: AdminUser
description: Set on Windows 2000 if the user has administrator privileges.

name: Alpha
description: The numeric processor level when running on an Alpha processor. Note: This property is obsolete, the Alpha platform is not supported by Windows Installer.

name: AppDataFolder
description: The full path to the Roaming folder for the current user.

name: BorderSide
description: The width of the window borders, in pixels.

name: BorderTop
description: The height of the window borders, in pixels.

name: CCP_DRIVE
description: The root path for qualifying products for CCP.

name: COMPADDDEFAULT
description: List of components to be installed in the default configuration.

name: COMPADDLOCAL
description: List of component IDs to be installed locally.

name: COMPADDSOURCE
description: List of component IDs to run from source media.

name: COMPANYNAME
description: Organization name of the user who is performing the installation.

name: CPACK_WIX_PRODUCT_GUID
description: The ProductCode GUID generated or specified by CPack.

name: CPACK_WIX_UPGRADE_GUID
description: The UpgradeCode GUID generated or specified by CPack.

name: CaptionHeight
description: The height of normal caption area, in pixels.

name: ColorBits
description: The number of adjacent color bits for each pixel.

name: CommonAppDataFolder
description: The full path to application data for all users.

name: CommonFiles64Folder
description: The full path to the predefined 64-bit Common Files folder.

name: CommonFilesFolder
description: The full path to the Common Files folder for the current user.

name: ComputerName
description: Computer name of the current system.

name: CostingComplete
description: Indicates whether disk space costing is complete.

name: DISABLEADVTSHORTCUTS
description: Set to disable the generation the specific shortcuts that support installation-on-demand.

name: DISABLEMEDIA
description: Prevents the installer from registering media sources, such as a CD-ROMs, as valid sources for the product.

name: DISABLEROLLBACK
description: Disables rollback for the current configuration.

name: Date
description: The current date.

name: DefaultUIFont
description: Default font style used for controls.

name: DesktopFolder
description: The full path to the Desktop folder.

name: DiskPrompt
description: String displayed by a message box that prompts for a disk.

name: EXECUTEACTION
description: Top-level action that ExecuteAction initiates.

name: EXECUTEMODE
description: Mode of execution that the installer performs.

name: FASTOEM
description: Improves installation performance under specific OEM scenarios.

name: FILEADDDEFAULT
description: List of file keys for files to be installed in the default configuration.

name: FILEADDLOCAL
description: List of file keys for files to be run locally.

name: FILEADDSOURCE
description: List of file keys to be run from the source media.

name: FavoritesFolder
description: The full path to the Favorites folder for the current user.

name: FontsFolder
description: The full path to the Fonts folder.

name: INSTALLFOLDER
description: The default identifier for the main installation directory.

name: INSTALLLEVEL
description: Initial level where features are installed.

name: Installed
description: Indicates that a product is already installed.

name: Intel
description: The numeric processor level when running on an Intel processor.

name: Intel64
description: The numeric processor level when running on an Itanium processor.

name: IsAdminPackage
description: Set to 1 (one) if the current installation is running from a package created through an administrative installation.

name: LIMITUI
description: UI level capped as Basic.

name: LOGACTION
description: List of action names to be logged.

name: LeftUnit
description: Places units to the left of the number.

name: LocalAppDataFolder
description: The full path to the folder that contains local (nonroaming) applications.

name: LogonUser
description: User name for the user who is currently logged on.

name: MEDIAPACKAGEPATH
description: This property must be set to the relative path if the installation package is not located at the root of the CD-ROM.

name: MSIARPSETTINGSIDENTIFIER
description: This optional property contains a semi-colon delimited list of the registry locations where the application stores a user's settings and preferences. Available with Windows Installer 4.0.

name: MSICHECKCRCS
description: The Installer does a CRC on files only if the MSICHECKCRCS property is set.

name: MSIDISABLEEEUI
description: Disable the embedded user interface for the installation. Windows Installer 4.0 and earlier: Not supported.

name: MSIDISABLELUAPATCHING
description: Setting this property prevents Least Privileged User (LUA) patching of an application.

name: MSIDISABLERMRESTART
description: Specifies how applications or services that are currently using files affected by an update should be shutdown and restarted to enable the installation of the update.

name: MSIENFORCEUPGRADECOMPONENTRULES
description: Set this property to 1 (one) on the command line or in the Property Table to apply the upgrade component rules during small updates and minor upgrades of a specific product. Available beginning with Windows Installer 3.0.

name: MSIFASTINSTALL
description: Reduce the time required to install a large Windows Installer package. Windows Installer 4.5 and earlier: Not supported.

name: MSIINSTALLPERUSER
description: Requests that the Windows Installer install the package only for the current user. Windows Installer 4.5 and earlier: Not supported.

name: MSIINSTANCEGUID
description: The presence of this property indicates that a product code changing transform is registered to the product.

name: MSINEWINSTANCE
description: This property indicates the installation of a new instance of a product with instance transforms.

name: MSINODISABLEMEDIA
description: Set this property to prevent the installer from setting the DISABLEMEDIA property.

name: MSIPATCHREMOVE
description: Setting this property removes patches.

name: MSIRESTARTMANAGERCONTROL
description: Specifies whether the package uses the Restart Manager or FilesInUse functionality.

name: MSIRMSHUTDOWN
description: Specifies how applications or services that are currently using files affected by an update should be shutdown to enable the installation of the update.

name: MSIUNINSTALLSUPERSEDEDCOMPONENTS
description: When this property has been set to 1, the installer can unregister and uninstall redundant components to prevent leaving behind orphan components on the computer. Windows Installer 4.0 and earlier: Not supported.

name: MSIUSEREALADMINDETECTION
description: Set this property to 1 to request that the installer use actual user information when setting the AdminUser property. This property is available starting with Windows Installer 4.0.

name: Manufacturer
description: Name of the application manufacturer. (Required)

name: MediaSourceDir
description: The installer sets this property to 1 (one) when the installation uses a media source, such as a CD-ROM.

name: MsiHiddenProperties
description: List of properties that are prevented from being written into the log.

name: MsiLogFileLocation
description: The installer sets the value of this property to the full path of the log file, when logging has been enabled. This property is available starting with Windows Installer 4.0.

name: MsiLogging
description: Sets the default logging mode for the Windows Installer package. This property is available starting with Windows Installer 4.0.

name: MsiNTProductType
description: Indicates the Windows product type.

name: MsiNTSuiteBackOffice
description: On Windows 2000 and later operating systems, the Installer sets this property to 1 (one) only if Microsoft BackOffice components are installed.

name: MsiNTSuiteDataCenter
description: On Windows 2000 and later operating systems, the Installer sets this property to 1 (one) only if Windows 2000 Datacenter Server is installed.

name: MsiNTSuiteEnterprise
description: On Windows 2000 and later operating systems, the Installer sets this property to 1 (one) only if Windows 2000 Advanced Server is installed.

name: MsiNTSuitePersonal
description: On Windows XP and later operating systems, the Installer sets this property to 1 (one) only if the operating system is Home (not Professional).

name: MsiNTSuiteSmallBusiness
description: On Windows 2000 and later operating systems, the Installer sets this property to 1 (one) only if Microsoft Small Business Server is installed.

name: MsiNTSuiteSmallBusinessRestricted
description: On Windows 2000 and later operating systems, the Installer sets this property to 1 (one) only if Microsoft Small Business Server is installed with the restrictive client license.

name: MsiNTSuiteWebServer
description: On Windows 2000 and later operating systems, the Installer sets the MsiNTSuiteWebServer property to 1 (one) if the web edition of the Windows Server 2003 is installed. Only available with the Windows Server 2003 release of the Windows Installer.

name: MsiNetAssemblySupport
description: On systems that support common language runtime assemblies, the Installer sets the value of this property to the file version of fusion.dll. The Installer does not set this property if the operating system does not support common language runtime assemblies.

name: MsiPatchRemovalList
description: List of patches to be removed during the installation.

name: MsiRestartManagerSessionKey
description: The Installer sets this property to the session key for the Restart Manager session.

name: MsiRunningElevated
description: The Installer sets the value of this property to 1 when the installer is running with elevated privileges.

name: MsiSystemRebootPending
description: The Installer sets this property to 1 if a restart of the operating system is currently pending.

name: MsiTabletPC
description: The installer sets this property to a nonzero value if the current operating system is Windows XP Tablet PC Edition.

name: MsiUIHideCancel
description: The Installer sets MsiUIHideCancel to 1 when the internal install level includes INSTALLUILEVEL_HIDECANCEL.

name: MsiUIProgressOnly
description: The Installer sets MsiUIProgressOnly to 1 when the internal install level includes INSTALLUILEVEL_PROGRESSONLY.

name: MsiUISourceResOnly
description: MsiUISourceResOnly to 1 (one) when the internal install level includes INSTALLUILEVEL_SOURCERESONLY.

name: MsiWin32AssemblySupport
description: On systems that support Win32 assemblies, the Installer sets the value of this property to the file version of sxs.dll. The Installer does not set this property if the operating system does not support Win32 assemblies.

name: Msix64
description: The numeric processor level when running on an x64 processor.

name: MyPicturesFolder
description: The full path to the Pictures folder.

name: NOCOMPANYNAME
description: Suppresses the automatic setting of the COMPANYNAME property.

name: NOUSERNAME
description: Suppresses the automatic setting of the USERNAME property.

name: NetHoodFolder
description: The full path to the NetHood folder.

name: OLEAdvtSupport
description: Set if OLE supports the Windows Installer.

name: OriginalDatabase
description: The installer sets this property to the launched-from database, the database on the source, or the cached database.

name: OutOfDiskSpace
description: Insufficient disk space to accommodate the installation.

name: OutOfNoRbDiskSpace
description: Insufficient disk space with rollback turned off.

name: PATCH
description: Setting this property applies a patch.

name: PATCHNEWPACKAGECODE
description: The value of this property is written to the Revision Number Summary Property.

name: PATCHNEWSUMMARYCOMMENTS
description: The value of this property is written to the Comments Summary Property.

name: PATCHNEWSUMMARYSUBJECT
description: The value of this property is written to the Subject Summary Property.

name: PIDKEY
description: Part of the Product ID that the user enters.

name: PIDTemplate
description: String used as a template for the PIDKEY property.

name: PRIMARYFOLDER
description: Allows the author to designate a primary folder for an installation. Used to determine the values for the PrimaryVolumePath, PrimaryVolumeSpaceAvailable, PrimaryVolumeSpaceRequired, and PrimaryVolumeSpaceRemaining properties.

name: PROMPTROLLBACKCOST
description: Action if there is insufficient disk space for the installation.

name: ParentOriginalDatabase
description: The installer sets this property for installations run by a Concurrent Installation action.

name: ParentProductCode
description: The installer sets this property for installations that a Concurrent Installation action runs.

name: PersonalFolder
description: The full path to the Documents folder for the current user.

name: PhysicalMemory
description: The size of the installed RAM, in megabytes.

name: Preselected
description: Features are already selected.

name: PrimaryVolumePath
description: The Installer sets the value of this property to the path of the volume that the PRIMARYFOLDER property designates.

name: PrimaryVolumeSpaceAvailable
description: The Installer sets the value of this property to a string that represents the total number of bytes available on the volume that the PrimaryVolumePath property references.

name: PrimaryVolumeSpaceRemaining
description: The Installer sets the value of this property to a string that represents the total number of bytes remaining on the volume that the PrimaryVolumePath property references if all the currently selected features are installed.

name: PrimaryVolumeSpaceRequired
description: The Installer sets the value of this property to a string that represents the total number of bytes required by all currently selected features on the volume that the PrimaryVolumePath property references.

name: PrintHoodFolder
description: The full path to the PrintHood folder.

name: Privileged
description: Runs an installation with elevated privileges.

name: ProductCode
description: A unique identifier for a specific product release. (Required)

name: ProductID
description: Full Product ID after a successful validation.

name: ProductLanguage
description: Numeric language identifier (LANGID) for the database. (REQUIRED)

name: ProductName
description: Human readable name of an application. (Required)

name: ProductState
description: Set to the installed state of a product.

name: ProductVersion
description: String format of the product version as a numeric value. (Required)

name: ProgramFiles64Folder
description: The full path to the predefined 64-bit Program Files folder.

name: ProgramFilesFolder
description: The Program Files folder (32-bit on 32-bit systems, or 32-bit on 64-bit systems).

name: ProgramFilesFolder
description: The full path to the predefined 32-bit Program Files folder.

name: ProgramMenuFolder
description: The full path to the Program Menu folder.

name: REBOOT
description: Forces or suppresses a restart.

name: REBOOTPROMPT
description: Suppresses the display of prompts for restarts to the user. Any restarts that are needed happen automatically.

name: REINSTALL
description: List of features to be reinstalled.

name: REINSTALLMODE
description: A string that contains letters that specify the type of reinstall to perform.

name: REMOVE
description: List of features to be removed.

name: RESUME
description: Resumed installation.

name: ROOTDRIVE
description: Default drive for an installation.

name: RecentFolder
description: The full path to the Recent folder.

name: RedirectedDllSupport
description: The Installer sets the RedirectedDllSupport property if the system performing the installation supports Isolated Components.

name: RemoteAdminTS
description: The Installer sets the RemoteAdminTS property when the system is a remote administration server running the Terminal Server role service.

name: ReplacedInUseFiles
description: Set if the installer installs over a file that is being held in use.

name: RollbackDisabled
description: The installer sets this property when rollback is disabled.

name: SEQUENCE
description: A table that has the sequence table schema.

name: SHORTFILENAMES
description: Causes short file names to be used.

name: ScreenX
description: The width of the screen, in pixels.

name: ScreenY
description: The height of the screen, in pixels.

name: SendToFolder
description: The full path to the SendTo folder for the current user.

name: ServicePackLevel
description: The version number of the operating system service pack.

name: ServicePackLevelMinor
description: The minor version number of the operating system service pack.

name: SharedWindows
description: Set when the system is operating as Shared Windows.

name: ShellAdvtSupport
description: Set if the shell supports feature advertising.

name: SourceDir
description: Root directory that contains the source files.

name: StartMenuFolder
description: The full path to the Start menu folder.

name: StartupFolder
description: The full path to the Startup folder.

name: System16Folder
description: The full path to folder for 16-bit system DLLs.

name: System64Folder
description: The full path to the predefined System64 folder.

name: SystemFolder
description: The full path to the System folder for the current user.

name: SystemLanguageID
description: Default language identifier for the system.

name: TARGETDIR
description: Specifies the root destination directory for the installation. During an administrative installation this property is the location to copy the installation package.

name: TRANSFORMS
description: List of transforms to be applied to a database.

name: TRANSFORMSATSOURCE
description: Informs the installer that the transforms for a product reside at the source.

name: TRANSFORMSSECURE
description: Setting the TRANSFORMSECURE property to 1 (one) informs the installer that transforms are to be cached locally on the user computer in a location where the user does not have write access.

name: TTCSupport
description: Indicates if the operating system supports using .ttc (true type font collections) files.

name: TempFolder
description: The full path to the Temp folder.

name: TemplateFolder
description: The full path to the Template folder for the current user.

name: TerminalServer
description: Set when the system is a server running the Terminal Server role service.

name: TextHeight
description: The height of characters, in logical units.

name: Time
description: The current time.

name: UILevel
description: Indicates the user interface level.

name: UPGRADINGPRODUCTCODE
description: Set by the installer when an upgrade removes an application.

name: USERNAME
description: User who is performing the installation.

name: UpdateStarted
description: Set when changes to the system have begun for this installation.

name: UpgradeCode
description: A GUID that represents a related set of products.

name: UserLanguageID
description: Default language identifier of the current user.

name: UserSID property
description: Set by the installer according to the security identifier (SID) of the user.

name: Version9X
description: Version number for the Windows operating system.

name: VersionDatabase
description: Numeric database version of the current installation.

name: VersionMsi
description: The installer sets this property to the version of Windows Installer that is run during the installation.

name: VersionNT
description: Version number for the operating system.

name: VersionNT64
description: Version number for the operating system if the system is running on a 64-bit computer.

name: VirtualMemory
description: The amount of available page file space, in megabytes.

name: Windows build
description: Build number of the operating system.

name: WindowsFolder
description: The full path to the Windows folder.

name: WindowsVolume
description: The volume of the Windows folder.
